sentences.text: On taking steps, let notice be served upon respondent No.4.

The rainy season is approaching the doors of the State and if the conditions of the road continue as it is, it will create more and more problem, therefore, the respondents Nos. 2, 3 and 4 are directed to take steps within 10 days from today for construction of the road in question and if there is any issue of compensation or any other issue, that will not come in the way to proceed further with the construction.

However, it is made clear that if any party is affected regarding the compensation that will not create problem for the reason that the said party may get adequate compensation as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
